theme_and_archetype.vibe: Arcade Utility, irreverent, high-impact, punchy but extremely clear to read. A gamer aesthetic applied to a real-world utility app.

typography.font_strategy: Anti-Default. Heavy, striking headings paired with a sterile/technical mono body to create an arcade/control-room tension.

rules.gradients: BANNED. Use solid, high-contrast blocks of color.
rules.shadows: Neo-brutalist solid drop shadows only (e.g., 4px 4px 0px #FACC15). No soft blurred box-shadows.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Mobile-First 'Tetris' Grid. Generous spacing (p-6, p-8) around critical interactive zones. Dense data (timers, meters) packed tightly like an arcade HUD.
spacing_and_layout.corners: rounded-none or max rounded-sm to maintain the harsh brutalist/retro look.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Exposed structural borders. 2px solid #FFFFFF or #3F3F46 on all interactive containers.

simulator_sandbox.description: The flagship feature. An interactive 'How to Make Cheese on Toast' simulator.
simulator_sandbox.container: Thick white borders, solid background. Arcade cabinet screen aesthetic.

states.mechanic: Live timer running 0:00 to 6:00+. User must tap 'TAKE IT OUT' at the right moment.

simulator_sandbox.controls: Massive, thumb-friendly buttons. 'Reset' button must appear prominently upon any failure.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-black border-2 border-primary hover:bg-black hover:text-primary transition-colors font-bold uppercase py-4 px-6
buttons.danger: bg-danger text-black border-2 border-danger hover:bg-black hover:text-danger
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent border-2 border-white text-white hover:bg-white hover:text-black

recipe_cards.layout: Bento-style blocks. Image taking up 60% of height. Bold title overlapping the border.

seo_and_pwa_strategy.pwa: Include mobile web-app meta tags (apple-mobile-web-app-capable), theme-color meta tag (#09090B), and configure manifest.json for standalone installation.
seo_and_pwa_strategy.seo: Dynamically injected <title> and <meta> descriptions. MUST use Schema.org JSON-LD 'Recipe' type for every recipe (Cheese on Toast, Fried Rice, Sushi, Boiled Rice). Use semantic <article> and <section> tags.

asset_nuclear_fail.description: Mushroom cloud nuclear explosion fail state

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: We are using purely JavaScript (.js/.jsx) files. Do NOT create or output .tsx or .ts files.

CRITICAL: Every interactive element, form, and state container MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='simulator-start-button', data-testid='disaster-meter', data-testid='recipe-card-sushi').
CRITICAL: Ensure the UI is heavily mobile-optimized (touch targets > 48px).
Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Import Unbounded and IBM Plex Mono via Google Fonts.
Build the 'How to Make Cheese on Toast' sandbox using React state to manage the 5 stages and the timer.
For the disaster states, use conditional rendering with Framer Motion (e.g. dramatic shaking for fire, intense scaling for nuclear).
Include schema.org JSON-LD structured data for recipes so Google picks up 'How to make cheese on toast'.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the marketing/landing page components. Use customized Shadcn UI (with sharp borders and no soft shadows) for utility elements if needed.
